slot_note: Lane AD, re-root of the AD11 slot after architecture 1 (disease surveillance, pooled-test infection rates) was spent on measurement; three 11-01 passes screened 37 Anomaly Detection candidates dead and the 11-03 pass moved the slot to banking's fraud and AML detection task type, a cell holding one live card (task196, scam incidence by capture-recapture).
niche: a British Columbia credit union's financial intelligence unit choosing which cash-intensive business members it takes into enhanced investigation in the first quarter of 2027, each member's 2026 cash paid in judged against the cash its walk-in trade produces
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field and the policy correctly scores each member's 2026 cash against its trade-and-size peers, against the expected activity it declared, or against its trade's cash share of everything else the account received, and refers honest members that grew or trade large, while the two fronts pass, because their laundered cash and their network's business receipts inflate exactly the measures those routes divide by.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a business member's cash beyond what its walk-in trade produces, the core quantity of cash-intensive business monitoring in anti-money-laundering work, estimated from the card acquirer settlements that measure the same counter trade independently of the cash; with hospitals or megawatt-hours in place of takeaways and salons there are no tills, card terminals or placement of criminal cash, so the task stops making sense.
layer1: narrative-coded postings: card acquirer settlements, delivery platform payouts, cash channels and business receipts each in their processor's own wording
core banking timestamps in UTC against Pacific branch business days
members holding more than one account
KYC profiles of different review vintages, some years stale
acquirer monthly merchant statements in PDF carrying gross sales against the net daily settlements
a member register whose industry codes were set at onboarding
an LCTR filing log keyed by report number rather than posting
stakeholder_role: the credit union's financial intelligence unit lead, who takes the first-quarter 2027 investigation slate to the AML compliance committee

spine.entity: one posting on a business member's account

driver: The decisive quantity is one kind of inflow beyond what a unit's own activity produces, and every benchmark built from the unit's peers, from what the unit declared or from the unit's other inflows moves with the anomaly, because the anomaly's owners set the declaration and supply the other inflows at will, so only the activity a third party records in a separate channel, carried through how that channel relates to the inflow across the whole population, separates the anomaly from size.
driver_concrete: Each business member's 2026 cash paid in is judged against the cash its walk-in trade produces, taken as its card acquirer settlements times its own trade's cash-to-card relation across the credit union's book, because the peer group, the member's declared expected activity and its other credits all move with the laundered cash: the fronts declared high expected activity at onboarding and receive their network's business-to-business payments.
stump: The solver refers the members its peer scores, declared activity or turnover shares put on top, honest members that grew since onboarding or trade large, and clears the two fronts, because it judges each member's cash against measures their laundered cash and their network's business receipts inflate, when only the walk-in trade their card acquirers settle shows each paid in about four times the cash its counter trade produces.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 on measurement and confirmed 2026-11-01: the decisive estimator family (pooled-test infection rates by maximum likelihood against the minimum infection rate) names one zone of 12 licensed constructions, so the step is a reflex; shipped 2026-10-13 and left at the portal, pending
lineage.niche: a county vector control district choosing the week's one aerial adulticide zone from CO2 and gravid trap collections and pooled RT-PCR results for West Nile virus
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a density of affected individuals estimated from grouped tests, where reading each positive group as a single affected individual understates the rate exactly where groups are large and the rate is high, and where the rate measured on individuals sampled by one collection method is carried onto the individuals another method collects, whose members have had more exposure.
